g.text: Revised 45-hole games · frontier models · high requested reasoning · native scripted opponents
Spokes average eligible hole-type execution rates. Win/exploration use the same 131/135 target × seed cases across all three models.
Hinted rescue uses each model’s own exploration misses in that cohort, with extra information and attempts. Execution does not establish articulated discovery.
